content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The concept of a crypto payment gateway for digital products is not a new idea, but its execution is often shrouded in technical jargon and platform-centric solutions. In reality, it's a straightforward infrastructure problem that requires a straightforward solution. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments, creators can build a fully operational online store that handles automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This is not a workaround; it's base-layer infrastructure that gives creators the freedom to sell their digital products without relying on platform fees or restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is the seamless integration of NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain in real-time, and the transaction details are automatically pushed to Supabase for order storage. Meanwhile, Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, ensuring that products are delivered instantly to customers via Google Drive. This architecture is not only scalable but also secure, with features like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured to protect against phishing and spam attacks.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators who are tired of relying on platform fees, restrictions, and limitations. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this architecture gives you the freedom to collect payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT and Bitcoin, with a mere 0.5% fee. With NOWPayments as the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification engine, you can say goodbye to Gumroad's 10% fee and hello to financial sovereignty.
This infrastructure is not a workaround; it's base-layer infrastructure that gives creators the freedom to sell their digital products without relying on platform fees or restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component plays a critical role in ensuring that transactions are processed securely and efficiently, giving creators the freedom to focus on what matters most: creating and selling their digital products.
